verified_facts.text: The tower rises 92 stories above the Loop and North Michigan Avenue.
verified_facts.excerpt: Soaring 92 stories above the Loop and North Michigan Avenue, Trump International Hotel & Tower® Chicago rises above other luxury hotels in Chicago.

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits along the Chicago River, with views of Navy Pier and its weekly seasonal fireworks show.
verified_facts.excerpt: situated along the Chicago River, resulting in incredible views of Navy Pier and its weekly seasonal fireworks show

verified_facts.text: The hotel is located near The Magnificent Mile.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located near The Magnificent Mile, this luxurious hotel in downtown Chicago is one of the tallest reinforced concrete buildings in the world

verified_facts.text: The building is one of the tallest reinforced concrete buildings in the world.
verified_facts.excerpt: this luxurious hotel in downtown Chicago is one of the tallest reinforced concrete buildings in the world

verified_facts.text: The hotel says it served as the inspiration for the Burj Khalifa and was designed by the mind behind that Dubai building.
verified_facts.excerpt: Trump Chicago served as the inspiration for the Burj Khalifa and was designed by the mind behind the renowned Dubai building

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms and suites have custom designed furnishings and floor-to-ceiling windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our incredibly appointed guest rooms and suites welcome you with custom designed furnishings, floor-to-ceiling windows, and fully equipped kitchens.

verified_facts.text: Every suite has a fully equipped kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: With fully-equipped kitchens available in every suite, you can savor the convenience and flexibility of home-cooked meals during your extended stay.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers its signature Trump Attache service.
verified_facts.excerpt: including the signature Trump Attaché™ service

verified_facts.text: Terrace 16 is a rooftop restaurant on the 16th floor with an indoor bar and dining room and an outdoor terrace overlooking the Chicago River, Lake Michigan and the city's architecture.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the 16th floor of Trump International Hotel & Tower Chicago, the rooftop restaurant features a lively indoor bar and dining room, along with an expansive outdoor terrace overlooking the Chicago River, Lake Michigan

verified_facts.text: Terrace 16 serves a seasonal New American menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: unmatched skyline views, and a seasonal New American menu

verified_facts.text: Terrace 16 offers views of Chicago's summer fireworks over the river on Wednesdays and Saturdays.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy front-row views of Chicago's iconic summer fireworks over the river every Wednesday at 9:00pm and Saturday at 10:00pm.

verified_facts.text: Terrace 16 asks guests to observe a business and chic casual dress code.
verified_facts.excerpt: We kindly ask all guests to observe our business and chic casual dress code.

verified_facts.text: Rebar, on the Mezzanine level, offers dining and cocktails along the Chicago River.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the Mezzanine level of Trump Chicago, Rebar provides a casual-chic, dynamic environment for dining and cocktails along the Chicago River.

verified_facts.text: Rebar serves Neo Japanese fare created by Kamehachi, with views of the Chicago River and the Michigan Avenue Bridge.
verified_facts.excerpt: unparalleled vistas of the Chicago River and the city’s famed Michigan Avenue Bridge paired with an ever-evolving menu of Neo Japanese fare created by Kamehachi

verified_facts.text: Rebar has live DJ entertainment on Friday and Saturday nights.

Live DJ Entertainment:**

Friday - Saturday: 9:00pm - 1:00am

verified_facts.text: The Spa at Trump overlooks the Chicago skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Spa at Trump® boasts 23,000 square-feet overlooking the Chicago skyline

verified_facts.text: The hotel features the Anthony Cristiano Salon.
verified_facts.excerpt: We offer Chicago spa packages and feature the city’s most sought after salon, Anthony Cristiano Salon.

verified_facts.text: The spa facilities include a swimming pool, a fitness club, a relaxation lounge, a steam room and a sauna.

Swimming Pool: 6:00am - 10:00pm

FItness Club: 24 hours

verified_facts.text: The spa offers treatments for individuals and couples.
verified_facts.excerpt: With its opulent treatments and soothing massages, meticulously crafted for individuals, and couples

verified_facts.text: Guests must be 16 or older to use the Fitness Club, and guests under 16 must be accompanied by an adult to use the pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests must be 16 years or older to use the Fitness Club. Guests under age 16 must be accompanied by an adult (18+) to use the pool and locker room amenities.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a Grand Ballroom, Salon Rooms and Boardrooms for events.
verified_facts.excerpt: The sophisticated design of the Grand Ballroom and incredible views of the Salon Rooms and Boardrooms each offer stunning settings

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler calls it Chicago's tallest hotel, with views of the Chicago River and skyline.
